description: This file defines the GameActivity class for an Android Tic Tac Toe game, managing game logic, user interactions, AI turns, and UI updates.

classes.name: GameActivity
classes.description: Main activity for managing the Tic Tac Toe game, handling game flow, user input, AI moves, and UI updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, and configures event listeners.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles activity resume state, sets initial turn, and check for game over conditions.

methods.name: selectTurn
methods.description: Sets the current player, updates UI elements to indicate turn.

methods.name: finishTurn
methods.description: Ends the current turn, checks for game completion, and transitions to the next player.

methods.name: checkGameFinished
methods.description: Evaluates the game board to determine if a player has won or the game is a tie.

methods.name: setFinished
methods.description: Updates game state to finished, disables input, and records win or tie.

methods.name: setWinState
methods.description: Displays game result message and enables navigation back.

methods.name: getOtherPlayer
methods.description: Returns the opposing player of the given player.
